correction_kind: implementation fidelity to the already frozen whole-alphabetic-token rule
reason: Independent synthetic tests found regex backtracking could count a bare cue inside an invalid apostrophe/digit suffix, and Python Unicode word classes admitted nonletter numerics to the alphabetic-token denominator.
fix: Consume maximal word-like candidates before checking every component with str.isalpha; allow at most one internal apostrophe. Combining marks stay with the candidate and cannot expose a false interior cue.
numeric_guard_clarification: The numeric-adjacency guard uses ASCII decimal digits0–9, one through four digits. Other numeric representations are not semantically classified.
